body: T11a-claude — leg 1 of the T11a three-way blind taste test (harness-tuning rematch 2026-08-06). Contract: .adlc/specs/T11a-claude.md (fork of the shared T11a slice spec; umbrella .adlc/specs/T11.md). Vehicle: claude-code, model claude-fable-5. Owns AC2 (delta vocabulary pinned in the genesis schema set), AC7 (validation at admission), AC10 (gates). Deliverables: Kyber.Schema (schema container actor: compiled set, live schema-delta subscription, validate/1 + resolve/1 -> typed objects) + the genesis hyperschema/schema deltas (lib/kyber/schema/genesis/) + codegen-as-derived-convenience. Gate: mix test green with schema tests (vocabulary fixtures validate; malformed refused; unknown admitted raw; resolve returns typed objects); deliverables exist (test -f lib/kyber/schema.ex && test -f test/schema_test.exs); rails-guard clean; format/warnings clean; no Process.sleep.
title: T11a-claude: schema layer — claude-code / Fable 5 leg (blind taste-test vehicle A)
